trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task — finish everything else and it unlocks.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Finish the story, the 100% checklist and the remaining activity trophies.
The Platinum unlocks the moment the last one pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the Gone Fishing mission early in the game. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Play through the story until the Gone Fishing mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's missions.
Finish the final mission of the chapter.
The trophy pops at the chapter end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It unlocks automatically at the end of the chapter.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's missions.
Finish the final mission of the chapter.
The trophy pops at the chapter end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It unlocks automatically at the end of the chapter.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's missions.
Finish the final mission of the chapter.
The trophy pops at the chapter end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically at the end of the chapter.
steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's missions.
Finish the final mission of the chapter.
The trophy pops at the chapter end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the final mission of the game — the last story trophy and one of only two Golds.
steps: Play through all five chapters.
Complete the final mission.
The trophy pops when the story ends.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the Breakfast Run mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Play through the story until the Breakfast Run mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Play through the story until The Cartel Heist mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the Child's Play mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Play through the story until the Child's Play mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the Headliners mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Play through the story until the Headliners mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the VCIA Takedown mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Play through the story until the VCIA Takedown mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the Operation Savage Glory mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Play through the story until the Operation Savage Glory mission appears.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: finish the 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which opens after the story. It is about 60% of everything in the game, and progress made during the story already counts.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist.

Work through the checklist: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and 15 of 18 meditations.
The trophy pops when the checklist hits 100% — usually the last trophy before the Platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. There are 397 in the game and the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this one.
steps: Find stunt jumps, bridges and base-jump spots around Leonida.
Complete 250 stunts of any kind.
The 100% checklist needs 300, so this trophy comes on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game once — races, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races and more. One try each is enough.
steps: Open the activities list and note every type.
Try each type once.
The trophy pops when the last untried type is done.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold at every shooting range challenge — 42 gold medals in total. Use Combat Focus and take your time on the harder ranges.
steps: Visit every shooting range in Leonida.
Learn each challenge's target pattern.
Earn a gold medal in all of them.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Learn the course lines — cutting corners costs more time than it saves.
steps: Find every Top Fun drone race location.
Win a race at each one.
The trophy pops after the last location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so spread out across race types and locations.
steps: Enter races across Leonida.
Win 20 different ones.
Replays of a race you already won do not count twice.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat his catch. Fish where the big ones bite and keep your line steady.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Fish the challenge and out-catch Cal.
The trophy pops when you win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to its end. Pick a short one if you just want the trophy.
steps: Find an arcade machine.
Start any arcade game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the final mission in Andy's strand. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Follow Andy's mission strand through the story.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the final mission in Kenton's strand. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Follow Kenton's mission strand through the story.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the final mission in Billy's strand. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Follow Billy's mission strand through the story.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands — the odd jobs for strangers marked around Leonida. The side-character final missions count toward the strand total.
steps: Look for Strangers & Freaks markers around Leonida.
Complete 8 full strands.
The trophy pops on the eighth strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the final mission in Randy's strand. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand through the story.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the final mission in Tyrone's strand. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission strand through the story.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.source: Exophase via PlanetGTA6; missable flag per PowerPyx
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, as Jason and Lucia. PowerPyx flags the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house as possibly missable: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a chapter-start save.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house.
Find the other 17 meditation spots across Leonida's 10 locations.
Meditate at every spot — the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his Strangers & Freaks strand. Track it, study it first if you want the 100% checklist credit, then take the shot.
steps: Follow Bret's strand until the hunt opens.
Track the unique animal.
Take it down to complete the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets hidden around Leonida. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so keep collecting after this pops.
steps: Find collectible cards around Leonida.
Complete 3 full sets.
The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so keep going.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Scan everything you pass — vehicles, animals and landmarks all count toward the habit.
steps: Use WAiNK It whenever you see a scannable subject.
Reach 100 different locations.
Scanning also feeds the 100% checklist (200 vehicles, 100 animals).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy comes on the way to the Platinum.
steps: Open the challenges list.
Complete any 50 challenges.
The checklist needs 70, so keep going after it pops.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears.
steps: Play with your partner and raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and leave the search area.
Escape clean — the trophy pops when the heat is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops and keep the heat on the whole way.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob the second and third back-to-back without losing the heat.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles around Leonida — scan them with WAiNK It as you find them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base vehicles scanned.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you see with WAiNK It.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.
Keep scanning — the checklist needs 200.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Enter Combat Focus with at least five enemies in front of you and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy firefight and line the shots up.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave without a schedule — steal a plane and take off on your own terms.
steps: Get to VCIA.
Steal a plane on the tarmac.
Take off — the trophy pops on your unscheduled departure.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is the tank — get behind the wheel of one and make the most of it while the heat is on.
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Climb in and drive it.
Survive the attention it brings.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean without ever being spotted. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and slip out before anyone raises the alarm.
steps: Case the jewelry store first.
Get in and out without being detected.
Escape clean for the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. All 8 vaults are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes on the way.
steps: Find and rob a bank vault, then escape.
Repeat for 5 vaults.
The checklist needs all 8, so keep going.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and get away clean — a classic GTA robbery. Block it, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the heat.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and rob it.
Escape with the cash.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every corner of Leonida until the map is fully revealed. A plane clears the fog fastest — grab one early in Chapter 1 and fly the whole state.
steps: Travel across all six regions of Leonida.
Clear the map fog everywhere.
The trophy pops when no fog is left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from every gang in Leonida. All 39 gang operations are needed for the 100% checklist.
steps: Find illegal gang operations around the state.
Rob one belonging to each gang.
The checklist needs all 39, so keep going.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and enjoy a cocktail there. The description is the whole hint — a quiet moment at the beach.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar or viewpoint overlooking the water.
Order and enjoy a cocktail with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Take a car through a vehicle showroom's front in classic GTA style — drive in, smash out, and keep going.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Get a car inside or drive one through the front.
Smash your way out and escape.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper game — follow through on every throw.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling.
Finish the game with full follow-through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is all the public information available: a partnership with mass appeal. Work through partner-based side content around Leonida and watch for it to pop.
steps: Play partner-based side content around Leonida.
Look for a partnership activity with a crowd or audience.
The trophy pops when the partnership lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This trophy is about the choices you make in the story. Play through and decide when the game asks — it pops on a decision that matters.
steps: Play through the story.
Make your choices when the game offers them.
The trophy pops on a significant decision.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Exophase via PlanetGTA6; method unconfirmed per PowerPyx
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — description only. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown; it is believed to relate to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but no tracker confirms how it unlocks, so this guide invents no method.
steps: No confirmed method yet — check PowerPyx and PSNProfiles for updates.
The current belief points to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Do not trust unconfirmed claims; wait for a tracker to confirm it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Exophase via PlanetGTA6; UFO method per PowerPyx
trophies.guide: Witness the UFO abduction event. PowerPyx confirms the method: at night after 2:00 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, find the blinking car at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to the UFO, talk to the woman it drops, then go back to her car — the UFO comes back for you and you wake up three days later.
steps: Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, alone, after 2:00 AM.
Find the blinking car at the roadside and follow the path into the woods.
Approach the UFO, talk to the woman it drops, then return to her car.
The UFO abducts you — you wake up three days later and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.source: Exophase via PlanetGTA6; method unconfirmed per PowerPyx
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed — description only. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown; it is believed to involve kicking enemies from a motorcycle, but no tracker confirms how it unlocks, so this guide invents no method.
steps: No confirmed method yet — check PowerPyx and PSNProfiles for updates.
The current belief points to kicking enemies from a motorcycle.
Do not trust unconfirmed claims; wait for a tracker to confirm it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Robberies pay in Marked Bills — move them through contacts to turn them into clean cash.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida — clothes, food, weapons, anything counts. Big purchases help, but it all adds up.
steps: Shop around Leonida as you play.
Spend across any shops.
The trophy pops at $100,000 total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Check the property listings as new ones open up and buy them all.
steps: Find garage properties for sale.
Buy each one.
The trophy pops when the last garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida and add them to the app one by one.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register vehicles you find.
Reach 10 registered vehicles.
